sloka: कच्चिदष्टादशान्येषु स्वपक्षे दश पञ्च च ।त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविज्ञातैर्वेत्सि तीर्थानि चारकै: ॥ २.१००.३७॥
transliteration: kaccidaṣṭādaśānyeṣu svapakṣe daśa pañca ca ।tribhistribhiravijñātairvetsi tīrthāni cārakai: ॥ 2.100.37॥

translations.english: O slayer of foes, I hope you are always alert about your foes who were defeated by you and have come back. You should not ignore your enemies thinking they are weak.
